text: England, April 2020. Lockdown. A 99-year-old war veteran set a goal: 100 laps of his garden, with his walker, before his 100th birthday. He hoped to raise £1,000 for the NHS. People started donating. Then the whole world did. *Over £32 million.* He finished early and kept walking. The Queen knighted him. *Captain Tom never stopped.* Send this to someone who inspires you.
